authoritative_sources_checked.result: The paper defines the strategy state/annotation protocol and reports the analyzed corpus, but the public paper text audited in this recheck does not bind that corpus to an explicit Hugging Face commit/revision or expose an official strategy-label export.

The public dataset exposes source trajectories and a structured agent/benchmark/base-model/job-id tree. The dataset main is mutable; the S0 metadata audit observed main commit 39d3fcd794df51c062c8bd3b7f8523ba707aaeb3. No paper-specific immutable revision binding was found in the audited public documentation.
The public benchmark repository documents the benchmark/runtime, but the repository currently exposes no GitHub release that can serve as a paper-v1 snapshot binding.

non_authoritative_consistency_signal.interpretation: This discrepancy is not used as scientific evidence or as an authoritative corpus count. It is only a consistency warning that downstream users can obtain a corpus cardinality different from the paper's 1,338 trajectories if they analyze an unpinned or filtered public dataset state.

recheck_findings.consequence: Do not assume current Hugging Face main equals the paper's analyzed 1,338-trajectory corpus.
Do not treat locally inferred strategy-family changes as source-authored labels without an independently frozen reconstruction protocol.
There is no official GitHub release shortcut that closes the paper-v1 provenance gap.
The direction remains support-feasible in principle; this is a HOLD rather than a scientific STOP.

only_valid_reopen_paths.requirement: Obtain an author/official artifact that binds arXiv:2608.19072v1 to an immutable PostTrainBench-Trajectories commit, manifest, release, or equivalent content-addressed corpus snapshot, plus the strategy annotation export or its exact content-addressed derivation.

Freeze Appendix A.2/A.4-compatible strategy definitions and annotation procedure before reading continuation outcomes, pin a source trajectory revision, independently reconstruct labels from the source-visible executed commands/context, audit annotation reliability on a held-out subset, and treat the resulting labels as reconstructed rather than source-authored.

forbidden_reopen_shortcuts: use the mutable current Hugging Face main because its directory names look compatible with the paper
infer that 1,338 paper trajectories equal every currently visible public run
use a third-party run count as the authoritative paper corpus
hand-pick trajectories whose apparent strategy labels fit the candidate hypothesis
download the full 28.9 GB corpus before a valid reopen path is frozen
advance to S1, provider calls, or ProblemGate while this provenance hold remains unresolved
